data.name: FirstRunLede
data.value: It reads everything underneath, works out which photos are copies of each other, and hands you a clean library to export. All of it on this machine.

data.name: EnterScansHint
data.value: Enter scans. A leading ~ expands to your home folder.

data.name: SupportedFormats
data.value: Reads JPEG · PNG · WebP · GIF · TIFF · BMP. HEIC/HEIF, AVIF and camera RAW are counted and reported, never touched — so a folder of iPhone photos never looks like an empty scan.

data.name: OriginalsStayPutBody
data.value: Scanning only reads. Files move in exactly two cases, both of which you have to ask for: an export in Move mode, or ticking "also recycle what I didn't pick".

data.name: NeverHardDeletedBody
data.value: Delete means the Recycle Bin. Every batch lands in History with a Restore next to it, for as long as the bin holds it.
